question: Can one additional source-admitted query view reverse the initial correlated Top-1 error while the target was already reachable in the initial Top-3, and can a local one-step view do so?

extra_view_roster.interpretation: All fourteen extra-view rankings were produced by the unchanged generic materializer. Its inherited authority label does not change this consumed-family oracle authority.

panel.oracle_selection: Among extra views whose unchanged Top-1 proposal overlaps target truth at IoU at least 0.5, maximize best target fused score minus best wrong fused score; tie by higher Top-1 IoU then earlier frame.
panel.local_oracle_selection: Apply the same margin rule within frames 84 and 85 only.

decision_gate.interpretation: A pass establishes a view-conditioned scoring ceiling only: an initially misranked but reachable target becomes Top-1 from at least one local additional observation.

literature_motivation.source: PInVerify: An Offline Embodied Benchmark for Active Instance Verification
literature_motivation.use: Evaluate the oracle ceiling before policy learning because reported random, angular-farthest and MLLM NBV strategies did not show reliable gains.

literature_motivation.source: Active Perception for Ambiguous Objects Classification
literature_motivation.use: Choose a view by reduction in ambiguity between the target and current wrong candidates, not by visibility or distance alone.

forbidden_after_freeze: change query views, proposal roster, model scores, IoU gate, Top-1 definition, local-view group or margin selection
claim that every extra view helps, conflate local and wide-baseline evidence, or present the oracle as a learned/runnable action policy
claim cross-view persistence of the same three hypotheses: the experiment reruns the unchanged detector/scorer per view and does not yet associate hypothesis identities across views
claim_boundary: This consumed-family Development result can establish only that query-side observation choice has a nonzero local oracle ceiling for target Top-1 under the unchanged scorer. It does not establish a deployable view selector, cross-view identity association, fresh transfer, calibrated uncertainty, exact-instance binding, portal ownership, affordance, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, benefit, reliability or safety.
